# Global Life School

> Global Life School is a boarding and day school in Kamalbinayak-10, Bhaktapur, Nepal, offering Pre-Primary through Secondary (SEE) education with a focus on academic excellence, discipline, and holistic growth. Established 2009.

Global Life School serves 500+ students with 40+ teachers across four stages: Pre-Primary, Primary, Lower Secondary, and Secondary (through the SEE board exams), following Nepal's National Education Board (NEB) curriculum.

## Pages

- [Home](https://globallife-web.vercel.app/): Overview of the school, hero introduction, enrollment stats, and featured academic programs.
- [About](https://globallife-web.vercel.app/about): School mission, vision, core values, a history timeline from founding to today, and a message from the Principal.
- [Academics](https://globallife-web.vercel.app/academics): Detailed breakdown of academic phases — Lower Secondary, Grade 9, and Grade 10 SEE preparation — including subjects taught at each phase.
- [Team](https://globallife-web.vercel.app/team): Faculty and staff directory, organized by department (Administration, Secondary, Primary, Pre-Primary).
- [Contact](https://globallife-web.vercel.app/contact): Location, phone numbers, email, office hours, and an admissions enquiry form.
